findings.title: Missing second cache check after acquiring write lock
findings.body: After the RLock fast-path miss, GetWebAssets acquires entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock() but never re-checks entryPointAssetsCache before doing I/O. Two goroutines that miss concurrently will therefore both read assets-manifest.json / CDN sequentially and both overwrite the global. Worse, a loser that fails can overwrite a winner's good value with nil. Re-check the cache under the write lock and return early if it is now populated.

findings.title: Failed load overwrites valid cache with nil
findings.body: entryPointAssetsCache = result is executed unconditionally, even when readWebAssetsFromFile/readWebAssetsFromCDN returned an error and result is nil. In Dev mode (where the early return is bypassed) or on concurrent missed loads, this discards a previously cached good value and forces every subsequent request to fail/re-read instead of falling back to stale good assets. Only assign the global on success (err == nil && result != nil).
